edition.en: Translation by Louise and Aylmer Maude in Twenty-three Tales (Oxford, 1906), as transcribed on Wikisource
edition.zh: 据维基文库所录路易丝·莫德与艾尔默·莫德译本，收入《二十三个故事》（牛津，1906）

basis.en: Written in 1903; the author died in 1910; the Maudes’ translation was published in 1906, and they died in 1938 and 1939.
basis.zh: 1903 年作，作者卒于 1910 年；莫德夫妇的译本 1906 年出版，二人分别卒于 1938 年和 1939 年。

note.en: A parable. A king wants to know the right time, the right people and the right thing to do; a hermit answers by letting him dig a garden bed. The answer, “there is only one time that is important—Now”, is plain, and the story makes it feel earned rather than handed down.
note.zh: 一则寓言。国王想知道做事的正确时机、最需要的人和最重要的事；一位隐士让他挖了一畦菜地，作为回答。答案——“只有一个时间是重要的：现在”——朴素得很，故事却让人觉得它是挣来的，而不是被训诫的。

excerpt.orig: Remember then: there is only one time that is important—Now!
excerpt.en: Remember then: there is only one time that is important—Now!
excerpt.zh: 那么记住吧：只有一个时间是重要的——现在！
